evals.prompt: Review the branch comparison report at {fixture}/comparison.md. Produce a concise, evidence-backed review using the review-git-branch output format. Keep the fixture read-only.
evals.expected_output: A semantic branch summary followed by correctness, security, test status, evidence-backed findings, and limitations.

evals.prompt: Inspect {fixture}/comparison.md. The comparison command did not produce a non-empty diff. Explain why a code review cannot proceed and what explicit input is needed. Do not invent findings or test results.
evals.expected_output: A fail-safe response that identifies the empty comparison and requests an explicit base ref.

evals.prompt: Review the branch comparison report at {fixture}/comparison.md. Separate observed code evidence from unverified test and runtime assumptions, and report the review in the standard output format.
evals.expected_output: A review that covers correctness, security, tests, changed files, evidence limits, and explicitly labels tests that were not run.
